card.name: "which" after addiction, abuse, and misuse
card.fires_on: The word "which" right after a comma following "addiction, abuse, and misuse" in opioid boxed warnings. It introduces the clause that follows, "can lead to overdose and death".

modes.label: Which after misuse
modes.description: A relative "which" after a comma that ends the list of addiction, abuse, and misuse risks in an opioid warning.
modes.example: Oxycodone Hydrochloride Oral Solution exposes users to risks of addiction, abuse, and misuse,<< which>> can lead to overdose and death. Assess

card.writes: It suggests a clause about a consequence rather than a concern or worry, since words like concern and worry are suppressed.
card.plain: It fires on the word "which" that links opioid addiction and misuse risks to the statement about overdose and death.
